Q: How did you come up with the idea for PayPal?
I thought,
What was essentially digital? What exists in the form of information, but is not high bandwidth?
In 1999, most people still had modems, so video was not really feasible. Money is low bandwidth and mostly digital. What can we do to make money work better?

elon/elon-03/elon-03:Efa5db5af4f22e7a3.text:
The 1990s financial infrastructure was a bunch of ancient mainframes, running ancient code, doing batch processing with poor security, and a series of heterogeneous databases. A herky-jerky frickin’ monstrosity.
From an information theory standpoint, finance would be much better if it could be real-time, secure, and fast. Essentially just one real-time database. Let’s try to build that.
elon/elon-03/elon-03:Efa5db5af4f22e7a3.speaker: musk_via_book
elon/elon-03/elon-03:Efa5db5af4f22e7a3.source_status: Curated/edited book; original recording or tweet not independently verified
